hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if [ ! -f package-lock.json ]; then echo "No package-lock.json yet: run npm install --ignore-scripts once."; exit 0; fi; s=$(node -p "require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync('package-lock.json')).digest('hex')") || exit 1; if [ "$s" != "$(cat node_modules/.kit-stamp 2>/dev/null)" ]; then npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund >&2 && printf '%s\n' "$s" > node_modules/.kit-stamp || exit 1; fi; cat node_modules/@raess/astro-kit/docs/INDEX.md
